name: Verify your email
description: Sent after sign-up and when someone asks to resend the verification link. The link works for 24 hours.
subject: Confirm your email for {{appName}}
preheader: One tap to confirm {{recipientEmail}}. The link works for {{expiresIn}}.
htmlBody:
Confirm your email

Hi {{recipientName}},

Confirm that {{recipientEmail}} is yours so {{appName}} can send your weekend plans. The link works for {{expiresIn}}.

Confirm my email

If the button does not work, paste this address into your browser: {{verificationLink}}

{{appName}} · {{currentYear}}

name: Reset your password
description: Sent when someone asks to reset a forgotten password. The link works for 60 minutes and once only.
subject: Reset your {{appName}} password
htmlBody:
Reset your password

Hi {{recipientName}},

Someone asked to reset the password for {{recipientEmail}}. The link works for {{expiresIn}}, once.

If it was not you, ignore this email and your password stays the same.

Choose a new password

If the button does not work, paste this address into your browser: {{resetLink}}

{{appName}} · {{currentYear}}
